# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

The search results didn't include direct store pages for most of these, so the links go to the guides where each pair is listed with current buy buttons. Prices shift often, so check before you buy.

**Best overall value: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro (about $120-$150)**
- It lists at $149.99. One retailer-affiliated page says code AFSC20 brings it to about $120 at Soundcore's US store. I couldn't verify that code myself. [Buy link (affiliate)](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro) · [Details](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150-2026-reviews-prices)
- SoundGuys rated it 8.2/10, with LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging. Its ANC beat 63% of the earbuds SoundGuys measured, and battery was about 5h 42m with ANC on. ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/))
- The newer Liberty 5 Pro is RTINGS' best mid-range pick, but at $169.99 it's over your budget.

**Best ANC under $150: Nothing Ear (3) (just under $150)**
- SoundGuys scored its ANC 8.2/10, with LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging. Downsides are bass-heavy tuning, muffled mics and about 5 hours per charge. ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/), [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/))

**Best for Android/Samsung: Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro (about $134)**
- SlashGear lists a new pair from Samsung's Amazon store at $134. It has adaptive ANC and IPX7 water resistance. ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/))

**Best for iPhone: AirPods Pro 2 (about $150, renewed)**
- SlashGear says a renewed pair is available for just under $150 on sale, since Apple no longer sells them new. Their ANC is excellent, but you lose some features on Android. ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/))
- The new AirPods 5 ($129, or $149 with wireless charging) have open-fit ANC, which blocks less noise than sealed buds. ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/))

**Best cheaper options**
- **Sony WF-C710N (about $119-$128):** What Hi-Fi? calls it the best budget pick, with fulsome, controlled bass. ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise))
- **Soundcore P31i ($59.99):** Adaptive ANC, multipoint and IP55. Its ANC is weaker, but it's good value. ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/))
- **Soundcore Space A40:** RTINGS' best budget ANC pick, though its mic is poor for calls. No price was listed. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds))

**My pick:** For most people, the Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro. If you're on iPhone, get a renewed AirPods Pro 2. If you're on Samsung, get the Galaxy Buds3 Pro.

The very best ANC (Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds 2nd Gen at about $299, Sony WF-1000XM6) costs well over $150.
